      "evidence": "Changes net_processing block-serving logic for MSG_BLOCK and is labeled P2P.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "speedup",
      "rationale": "Optimizes serving disk-backed MSG_BLOCK P2P requests by stripping witness bytes in place, achieving an 8.9x to 9.3x microbenchmark speedup over full block deserialization and reserialization. While worthwhile for resource usage and unblocking witnessless IBD work (#36476), legacy non-witness block requests are not the dominant path for modern peers."
    },

      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,

      "band": "Unranked",

      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The PR touches test and bench files only to add benchmarks and fuzz coverage pinning the new block serialization path."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/node/blockstorage and primitives/transaction.h solely to support P2P serialization without altering consensus, block validation, or chainstate invariants.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The block storage and transaction deserialization refactor exists only to support raw P2P block serving, with no substantive changes to validation logic or consensus rules."
